senses.gloss:
हुंकृत हुंकृत, i. e. हुम्-कृत (vb. कृ),
 I. adj. Uttered as an incantation.
 II. n.
 1. Incantation.
 2. Roar (of the thunder), Mālat. 151, 2.

हुम् हुम्, an interj.
 1. Of remembering, Ah! Utt. Rāmac. 136, 14.
 2. Of repulse, Away!
 3. Of interrogation, Hey?
 4. Of assent, Yes.
 5. Of doubt.
 6. A mystical syllable used in incantations (cf. हुंकार, हुंकृत).

हूम् हूम्, an interj. (cf. हुम्),
 1. Of doubt, Humph! ha!
 2. Of interrogation, Hey?
 3. Of assent, Yes.
 4. Of anger, fear.
 5. Of laughing, Lass. 80, 1 (Prākṛ.).
 6. Of reproach, [] contempt, Lass. 2. ed. 48, 47; equivalent to ‘Be silent,’ Tush!
 7. Of aversion.
 8. A mystical syllable, Cf. हूंकार, हूंकृति.
